name: com.kingfisher.kclipboard
description: Two persisted history stacks for the Editor's clipboard: copy a component's values and paste them onto a component of the same type on a different GameObject, or copy a whole GameObject (with children) and paste it back later - not limited to Unity's native same-session, single-item clipboard. Pairs with K-Setting, the shared settings backend. Editor-only: nothing is compiled into player builds.
